# Amber finish colour sample

Amber is the studio name for colour swatch A17. The sample card calls for an ochre field and an uncoated border on the presentation board. It contains no chamber geometry, body support or kiln opening rule.

## Display arrangement
Place the swatch beside the neutral grey sample so the exhibition photograph records the comparison. A matching name does not make the colour card an equipment specification.
